name: Which Bob?
author: daddybannk
queryHints:
Four shapes of the query all work.
JOIN the roster to the scanner log.

EXCEPT: badges before 20261001,
minus badges on or after it.

Or GROUP BY the officer, then
HAVING MAX(date) < 20261001.

Or NOT IN, or a LEFT JOIN with
s.scan_id IS NULL.
caseHints:
He has no scan this month at all.
Look for the gap, not for a row.

Seven other officers also left last
month. Only one of them is a Bob.

Forty officers are called Bobby.
Bobby is not Bob.
